awards.title: 2023 Korean Language Flagship Center Summer Scholarship
awards.summary: This scholarship provides funds for tuition and expenses for enrollment in a Korean language program in summer 2023. The scholarship requires that you achieve a minimum of a “B” in your language program, demonstrate improvement in your language skills, and complete mandatory pre and post-summer assessments.
